justification: CSIFormer Baseline is selected as the official production checkpoint. While DANN provided slight domain gradient balancing during intermediate training epochs, it failed to bridge the micro-Doppler physical gap on zero-shot hand gestures (27.96% vs 28.53%) and introduced slight degradation to fall detection recall (97.73% vs 100.00%) and standard test accuracy (53.81% vs 54.14%). The baseline CSIFormer delivers superior life-safety guarantees (100% fall detection, 99.62% HAR), higher Top-3 candidate retention (91.91%), and smaller parameter overhead without auxiliary domain heads.
